index.title: Know Your Agent — enforcement infrastructure for AI agents | AEOESS
index.description: AEOESS builds enforcement infrastructure for AI agents. The Agent Passport System (APS) is an open Apache 2.0 protocol for cryptographic identity, scoped delegation, and signed receipts. Used by gateway, SDK, and conformance suites in production.
index.og_title: Know Your Agent — enforcement infrastructure for AI agents
index.og_description: Open Apache 2.0 protocol for AI agent identity, scoped delegation, gateway enforcement, and signed receipts. Built on the Agent Passport System.

protocol.title: Agent Passport System — the open protocol | AEOESS
protocol.description: Four cryptographic primitives — Identity, Delegation, Enforcement, Receipt — composed into one trust fabric for AI agents. IETF Internet-Draft, Apache 2.0, byte-parity verifiable across SDK implementations.
protocol.og_title: Agent Passport System — the open protocol
protocol.og_description: Four primitives, one trust fabric. Identity, delegation, enforcement, signed receipts. Open protocol, Apache 2.0.

payments.title: Agentic payments — bind a key to a budget | AEOESS
payments.description: Per-agent, per-call, per-day spending caps. Merchant allow-lists. Five-gate preflight before any payment touches the rails. APS receipts compose with ACP, A2A, and ERC-8004 commerce primitives.
payments.og_title: Agentic payments — bind a key to a budget
payments.og_description: Per-agent spending caps, allow-listed merchants, five-gate preflight, signed payment receipts.

content.title: Content provenance for AI agents | AEOESS
content.description: Governance blocks, signed access receipts, and IPR envelopes. Every page-view by a passport-bound agent leaves a receipt. Revoke a source — derivatives expire across the network.
content.og_description: Governance blocks, access receipts, IPR envelopes. Revocation cascades through derivatives.

compliance.title: Compliance receipts auditors can verify | AEOESS
compliance.description: Eight governance primitives mapped to EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and SR 11-7. Export a signed log, verify byte-for-byte against the public spec. Auditors don't need to trust us.
compliance.og_description: Cryptographic governance for AI agents. Mapped to EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, SR 11-7.

enterprise.title: Agent control plane for your org | AEOESS
enterprise.description: Bring your own identity format — did:key, did:web, SPIFFE, OAuth. Inventory, scope, audit, and revoke every agent through one console. Self-host or managed gateway.
enterprise.og_title: The agent control plane for your org
enterprise.og_description: Bring your own identity. Inventory, scope, audit, revoke. Self-host or managed.

opensource.og_description: SDKs in TypeScript and Python. Self-host the gateway free. Apache 2.0 forever.
